steps.name: Given: Given a scarcity notice has started a 14-day choose clock and 30-day notice clock for a household with two holdings
When: When the household chooses one holding before the choose deadline
Then: Then that holding is identified for loss at the notice deadline
Then: And the household keeps using it until the notice deadline
Then: And its other holding is not identified for loss
